description: Campaigns running under a specific Display inventory slot for one period. Filter by ad_unit (required) and optionally page_type; returns per campaign-group rows: merchant id/name, os_client_id, campaign-group id/name/type/status/subtype, start/end date, bidding-strategy type, merchant remaining balance, daily budget, spend (raw cost, NOT currency-converted) and CPM. Only rows with cost > 0 that are either BLOCK_BUY or ACTIVE inventory configurations.

merchant_id.description: Merchant (seller) id owning the campaign group.

os_client_id.description: OnlineSales advertiser client id for the merchant.

campaign_group_type.selector: CASE WHEN (JSON_EXTRACT_SCALAR(mcgd.metadata, '$.isEanEnabled') = 'true' AND ctd.vendor IN ('google', 'facebook', 'tiktok')) THEN 'Offsite Ad' WHEN mcgd.campaign_type = 'PERFORMANCE' THEN 'Sponsored Product Ad' WHEN mcgd.campaign_type IN ('AWARENESS', 'INVENTORY') THEN 'Sponsored Display Ad' WHEN mcgd.campaign_type IN ('OFFSITE') THEN 'Offsite Ad' ELSE 'Sponsored Offsite Ad' END
campaign_group_type.description: Derived product family of the campaign group (Sponsored Product Ad / Sponsored Display Ad / Offsite Ad / Sponsored Offsite Ad).

campaign_group_status.description: Effective status of the campaign group with underscores replaced by spaces.

campaign_group_start_date.description: Campaign-group start date in the marketplace timezone (from marketplace_clients.timezone).

campaign_group_end_date.selector: CASE WHEN DATETIME(TIMESTAMP(mcgd.end_date, 'UTC'), mc.timezone) >= '2036-01-01' THEN NULL ELSE CAST(DATE(TIMESTAMP(mcgd.end_date, 'UTC'), mc.timezone) AS STRING) END
campaign_group_end_date.description: Campaign-group end date in the marketplace timezone; NULL for effectively open-ended (>= 2036-01-01).

campaign_group_subtype.selector: CASE WHEN (JSON_EXTRACT_SCALAR(mcgd.metadata, '$.isEanEnabled') = 'true' AND ctd.vendor IN ('google', 'facebook', 'tiktok')) THEN 'Manual' WHEN mcgd.campaign_type = 'PERFORMANCE' AND mcgd.campaign_subtype = 'SMART_SHOPPING' AND ((mcgd.bidding_strategy IN ('AUTO_CPC', 'AUTO_CPM') AND mcgd.objective_name IN ('Visitors', 'Visibility')) OR mcgd.objective_name = 'Absolute Revenue') THEN 'Smart Shopping' WHEN mcgd.campaign_type = 'PERFORMANCE' AND mcgd.objective_name IN ('Visitors', 'Visibility') AND mcgd.bidding_strategy IN ('CPC', 'CPM') THEN 'Manual' WHEN mcgd.campaign_type = 'PERFORMANCE' AND mcgd.campaign_subtype = 'OS_ADS_SEARCH' THEN 'Search-Only' WHEN mcgd.campaign_type IN ('AWARENESS', 'INVENTORY') AND mcgd.campaign_subtype = 'AUCTION' THEN 'Auction' WHEN mcgd.campaign_type IN ('AWARENESS', 'INVENTORY') AND mcgd.campaign_subtype = 'BLOCK_BUY' THEN 'Guaranteed' WHEN mcgd.campaign_type IN ('AWARENESS', 'INVENTORY') AND mcgd.campaign_subtype = 'PRE_AUCTION' THEN 'Auction Packages' WHEN mcgd.campaign_type IN ('OFFSITE') AND mcgd.campaign_subtype IN ('FACEBOOK_PRODUCT_AD', 'FACEBOOK', 'FACEBOOK_CAROUSEL_AD') THEN 'Facebook' WHEN mcgd.campaign_type IN ('OFFSITE') AND mcgd.campaign_subtype IN ('FACEBOOK_DPA') THEN 'Facebook DPA' WHEN mcgd.campaign_type IN ('OFFSITE') AND mcgd.campaign_subtype IN ('GOOGLE_PERFORMANCE_MAX_SHOPPING', 'GOOGLE_PERFORMANCE_MAX') THEN 'Google Performance Max' WHEN mcgd.campaign_type IN ('OFFSITE') AND mcgd.campaign_subtype IN ('GOOGLE_PRODUCT_AD', 'GOOGLE_SEARCH_TEXT_AD') THEN 'Google' WHEN mcgd.campaign_type IN ('OFFSITE') AND mcgd.campaign_subtype IN ('TIKTOK_TRAFFIC') THEN 'Tiktok Traffic' WHEN mcgd.campaign_type IN ('OFFSITE') AND mcgd.campaign_subtype IN ('TIKTOK_REACH') THEN 'Tiktok Reach' END
campaign_group_subtype.description: Derived campaign-group subtype label (Smart Shopping / Manual / Search-Only / Auction / Guaranteed / Auction Packages / Facebook / Google / Tiktok variants).

merchant_remaining_balance.selector: ROUND(CASE WHEN ROUND(mmd.remaning_balance, 0) <= 0.01 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(mmd.remaning_balance, 0) END, 2)
merchant_remaining_balance.description: Merchant remaining wallet balance (floored to 0 when <= 0.01).

campaign_group_daily_budget.description: Current daily budget configured on the campaign group.

campaign_group_bidding_strategy_type.selector: CASE WHEN (mcd.campaign_type = 'PERFORMANCE' AND mcd.objective_name IN ('Visitors', 'Visibility') AND mcd.bidding_strategy = 'AUTO_CPC') THEN 'Max Performance CPC' WHEN (mcd.campaign_type = 'PERFORMANCE' AND mcd.objective_name IN ('Visitors', 'Visibility') AND mcd.bidding_strategy = 'AUTO_CPM') THEN 'Max Performance CPM' WHEN (mcd.campaign_type = 'PERFORMANCE' AND mcd.objective_name IN ('Visitors', 'Visibility') AND mcd.bidding_strategy IN ('CPM', 'CPC')) THEN mcd.bidding_strategy WHEN mcd.campaign_type IN ('INVENTORY', 'AWARENESS') AND mcd.campaign_subtype = 'PRE_AUCTION' THEN 'NA' WHEN mcd.objective_name IN ('Absolute Revenue') THEN 'ROI' WHEN mcd.objective_name IN ('Visibility', 'Reach') AND mcd.campaign_subtype = 'AUCTION' THEN UPPER(JSON_EXTRACT_SCALAR(mcd.campaign_setting_metadata, '$.bidding_strategy_type')) WHEN mcd.objective_name IN ('Visibility', 'Reach') AND mcd.campaign_subtype = 'BLOCK_BUY' AND JSON_EXTRACT_SCALAR(mcd.campaign_setting_metadata, '$.bidding_strategy_type') = 'CPM' THEN 'Fixed CPM' WHEN mcd.objective_name IN ('Visibility', 'Reach') AND mcd.campaign_subtype = 'BLOCK_BUY' AND JSON_EXTRACT_SCALAR(mcd.campaign_setting_metadata, '$.bidding_strategy_type') = 'CPD' THEN 'CPD' ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END
campaign_group_bidding_strategy_type.description: Derived bidding-strategy label for the campaign group.

ad_unit.description: Display inventory ad-unit / slot name. REQUIRED per-call filter (case-sensitive equality on ad_unit_name).

page_type.description: Page type the inventory slot served on (SEARCH / CATEGORY / PRODUCT / HOME / ...). Optional per-call filter.

spend.selector: COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN rpt.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN rpt.cost ELSE 0 END), 2), 0)
spend.description: Inventory spend under this ad-unit slot (raw cost, NOT currency-converted; matches the source query).

cpm.selector: ROUND(CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN rpt.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN rpt.impressions ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN SUM(CASE WHEN rpt.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN rpt.cost ELSE 0 END) * 1000 / SUM(CASE WHEN rpt.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN rpt.impressions ELSE 0 END) ELSE 0 END, 2)
cpm.description: Cost per mille = spend * 1000 / impressions under this ad-unit slot (0 when no impressions).

query.REPORTING: SELECT __ATTRIBUTES__, __METRICS__ FROM `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.os_display_ads_ad_targeting_report` AS rpt INNER JOIN `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.agencies` AS ag ON ag.marketplace_client_id = rpt.marketplace_client_id AND ag.agency_id = '__AGENCY_ID__' INNER JOIN `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.monetize_merchant_dimensions` AS mmd ON mmd.marketplace_client_id = rpt.marketplace_client_id AND mmd.merchant_id = rpt.merchant_id AND mmd.agency_id = '__AGENCY_ID__' INNER JOIN `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.campaign_tagging_data` AS ctd ON ctd.client_id = rpt.client_id AND ctd.campaign_id = rpt.campaign_id INNER JOIN `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.marketing_campaign_group_dimensions` AS mcgd ON mcgd.marketing_campaign_group_id = ctd.marketing_campaign_group_id AND mcgd.client_id = ctd.client_id INNER JOIN `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.marketing_campaign_dimensions` AS mcd ON mcd.client_id = ctd.client_id AND mcd.marketing_campaign_id = ctd.marketing_campaign_id INNER JOIN `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.marketplace_clients` AS mc ON mc.marketplace_client_id = rpt.marketplace_client_id AND mc.agency_id = ag.agency_id AND mc.agency_id = mmd.agency_id LEFT JOIN `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.os_ads_db_campaign_inventory_configurations` AS oci ON SAFE_CAST(oci.marketplace_client_id AS STRING) = rpt.marketplace_client_id AND SAFE_CAST(oci.client_id AS STRING) = rpt.client_id AND SAFE_CAST(oci.campaign_id AS STRING) = rpt.campaign_id INNER JOIN `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.os_ads_db_status_types` AS st ON oci.status_type_id = st.id WHERE rpt.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' AND rpt.cost > 0 AND (mcgd.campaign_subtype = 'BLOCK_BUY' OR st.name = 'ACTIVE') AND __FILTER__ GROUP BY __ATTRIBUTES_GROUP_BY__;
